name: anyone-can-code
description: Reliability workflow for OpenAI Codex (Desktop + CLI, one plugin). Desktop auto memory when hooks trusted; CLI memory still manual (1.1.0-beta.4 level).

interface.shortDescription: Codex Desktop + CLI (one plugin): plan → build → verify. Desktop auto memory first.
interface.longDescription: Anyone Can Code is a free open-source reliability workflow plugin for OpenAI Codex. One install for Desktop and CLI. Desktop: full offline auto memory when hooks are trusted (v2.0.0-beta.4). CLI auto memory not yet — still 1.1.0-beta.4 level; use $learn / $wiki. Plan, build, resume, recover, and verify from plain English. Open beta.
defaultPrompt: I want to build something, but I may be starting from an idea, a repo, or a bug.
Resume my last workflow and tell me the next best step.
Verify what changed and tell me what is still uncertain.
